```{r}
#| message: FALSE 

library(tabr)
library(tidyverse)

movable_do <- function(solfege_str, key = "C", octave = 3) {
  # offsets in semitones relative to Do
  solfege_tbl <- tribble(
    ~syllable, ~note,
    "do",      "c",
    "di",      "c#",
    "ra",      "d_",
    "re",      "d",
    "ri",      "d#",
    "me",      "e_",
    "mi",      "e",
    "fa",      "f",
    "fi",      "f#",
    "se",      "g_",
    "sol",     "g",
    "so",      "g",
    "si",      "g#",
    "le",      "a_",
    "la",      "a",
    "li",      "a#",
    "te",      "b_",
    "ti",      "b",
    "r",       "r"
  )
  
  # Extract the tonic from the key 
  tonic <- tolower(sub("m$", "", key))
  key_offsets <- c(
    "c" = 0,
    "c#" = 1, "d_" = 1,
    "d" = 2, 
    "d#" = 3, "e_" = 3,
    "e" = 4, 
    "f" = 5,
    "f#" = 6, "g_" = 6,
    "g" = 7, 
    "g#" = 8, "a_" = 8,
    "a" = 9, 
    "a#" = 10, "b_" = 10,
    "b" = 11
  )
  
  shift <- key_offsets[tonic]
  if (is.na(shift)) stop("Invalid key. Use tabr format like 'g', 'b_', 'f#', or 'am'.")
  
  oct_diff <- octave - 3
  base_oct <- if (oct_diff > 0) {
    strrep("'", oct_diff)
  } else if (oct_diff < 0) {
    strrep(",", abs(oct_diff))
  } else {
    ""
  }
  
  notes_tbl <- tibble(token = str_split_1(str_squish(solfege_str), " ")) |>
    separate_wider_regex(
      token,
      patterns = c(syllable = "[a-zA-Z]+", extra_oct = ".*")
    ) |>
    mutate(syllable = str_to_lower(syllable)) |>
    left_join(solfege_tbl, by = "syllable")
  
  if (any(is.na(notes_tbl$note))) {
    bad <- unique(notes_tbl$syllable[is.na(notes_tbl$note)])
    stop("Unknown syllable(s): ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  converted_str <- notes_tbl |>
    mutate(full_note = if_else(note == "r",
                               str_c("r", extra_oct),
                               str_c(note, base_oct, extra_oct))) |>
    pull(full_note) |>
    str_c(collapse = " ")
  
  # Build string in C Major based off of solfege then transpose it 
  nw <- as_noteworthy(converted_str)
  if (shift > 0 || grepl("m$", tolower(key))) {
    nw <- transpose(nw, shift, key = key)
  }
  
  return(nw)
}
```
